test_primality: test if a number is prime using the 6k plus minus 1 optimization method
run_f_gold: run the f_gold function to check if a given integer is prime or not
create_primes_cli: create a python module that uses f_gold to check primality of numbers from command line args
refactor_f_gold: refactor the f_gold primality test function to support a range of numbers instead of one
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function which implements an optimized primality test using trial division
